meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先在你的项目知识图谱里定位你指定的文件、函数或模块，顺着它的调用关系、所属架构层和源码读一遍，再用不懂编程也能听懂的话讲清它做什么、连着谁、数据怎么走。
howto.when: 当你需要对某个文件、函数或模块做深入讲解时触发，需要带上它的路径作为参数；若项目里还没有知识图谱文件，它会先让你运行 /understand。

say.note: 定位该文件并讲它在架构中的位置

say.text: 深入讲讲 src/auth/login.ts:verifyToken 这个函数
say.note: 会追它调用了谁、又被谁调用

say.text: 解释一下 src/db 这个模块，我不懂 TypeScript
say.note: 用通俗语言读源码讲结构

howto.what_en: Claude looks up the file, function or module you name in the project's knowledge graph, follows its edges, layer and source, then explains its role, connections and data flow in plain language, even for readers unfamiliar with the language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a deep-dive explanation of a file, function or module; you pass a path, and if no knowledge graph exists yet it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.note: Finds the file and explains its place in the architecture

say_en.text: Explain the verifyToken function in src/auth/login.ts in depth
say_en.note: Traces what it calls and what calls it

say_en.text: Explain the src/db module; I don't know TypeScript
